flags.message: Forward cell: decisive post-snapshot public material was used. The Solicitor General's CVSG brief (filed 2026-08-31, recommending denial) and the 2026-09-16 redistribution for the 2026-10-09 conference postdate the provisioned 2026-04-07 snapshot. The petition is still pending (no disposition on the public docket), so this is ordinary forward signal, not leakage; the relist-increment claim is effectively realized by the observed redistribution.
